about: Flaky browser tests that CI leaves out (tests/e2e/quarantine.ts). Each failed on several unrelated PRs, trains or main, and passed on a rerun of the same commit. Run them locally with `bun run test:e2e:quarantine`; remove an entry once its fix passes there.

tests.title: a file opens over the thread, its comments are a sheet, and Back returns to the thread
tests.why: WebKit only (Pixel 7 passes): right after the thread opens, the count of running ib-push slide animations on the pane is not 1 (line 442, `expect(await pane.evaluate(slides)).toBe(1)`).

tests.title: a busy agent: the box offers the Ask window's choice, never says it draws; interrupt asks now; this round's picture has Show me again
tests.why: After Send with the fake agent set busy, the Show me box never turns `busy` within 15 s (line 538, `toHaveAttribute('data-show-me-box', 'busy')`).

dependents.title: round 2: the redrawn Overview tags its changed parts; a Show me picture stays as asked
dependents.why: It opens the round-1 picture of lines 7–9, which only the busy-agent test asks for.

dependents.title: the picture moves by its header like the window, stays in the pane, keeps its place, and a double-click puts it back
dependents.why: It opens `round2`, which only the round 2 test sets.

dependents.title: a phone at 390 px: the popover and the picture
dependents.why: It opens `round2`, which only the round 2 test sets.

dependents.title: reloaded while it draws, and the agent ends with no words: the box goes back to its words with the Ask window's note
dependents.why: It opens `round2`, which only the round 2 test sets.

dependents.title: the agent gone: a Show me it never answers goes back to the box with the Ask window's problem, never says it draws
dependents.why: It opens `round2`, which only the round 2 test sets.

tests.title: Delete removes the scratch folder and runs claude purge for it only
tests.why: The second Delete of the same launch must call no CLI, but the fake has one call more than before it (line 289, `expect(fake.calls()).toHaveLength(callsBefore)`: 12, expected 11).

tests.title: Review layer by layer: the layer's own diff, Next layer, Whole stack from the lowest open layer, and Approve into the agent's thread
tests.why: The migration's line 5 has no box yet when its height is measured (line 1009, `boundingBox()` returns null: "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'y')").

dependents.title: Reply at the stack's foot goes into the agent's thread
dependents.why: It replies on the stack page the layer test leaves open, after the approval it records (`verdictId`).

tests.title: desktop, read with another app in front: the reply on screen leaves the pill, and scrolling up never brings it back
tests.why: With another app in front, the new-messages pill does not go off for a reply already in view (line 305, `toHaveAttribute('data-off', '')`).

tests.title: the top bar holds what the rail held: chapters, the count, files, Overview, and the diff controls, by mouse and by keyboard
tests.why: After Enter on the third chapter in the jump menu, the top bar still reads "1 of 3" where "3 of 3" is expected (line 698, `expect(await jump.textContent()).toBe(place)`).

tests.title: a jump to a file nearby lands exactly
tests.why: After the first jump, to file 100 from the changed-files menu, the file settles 83 px above the top of the reader instead of 16 px below it (line 228, `expect(await settledPlace(page, body, fixture.paths[100])).toBe(PLACE)`: -83, expected 16).

tests.title: a thread's guided review with Code review off: arrows open a long file in place, the page scrolls with no box limit, the file header sticks, and a comment on an opened line saves
tests.why: The middle scroll check misses by a few hundred px (line 689, `expect(await scrollTop()).toBe(middle)`, e.g. 10932 vs 10512), and the runner was then killed (exit 137) on one run. Failed on three unrelated PRs (#2721 shape kit contrast, #2842 Shape run player, #2847 checklist line) that do not touch guided review.

tests.title: grouped: the same hover Mark read keeps the row in its group, not bold, and brings no news in
tests.why: After the hover Mark read is clicked, the row in New stays bold (line 333, `expect(row).not.toHaveClass(/\bib-u\b/)`: still "ib-row ib-u" after 15 s). Failed on three unrelated PRs (#2824 reply box, #2690 Reviews links, #2822 close keeps the draft) and passed on #2721's run of the same main.

dependents.title: grouped: with a read waiting in place, a snooze made elsewhere moves only its own row (review P1)
dependents.why: It needs the Grouped view, which the left-out test chooses; the test before it leaves List on.

dependents.title: grouped: an Archive waits in place, faded; after the list settles without it, its Undo brings the row back (review N1)
dependents.why: It needs the Grouped view too, and follows the snooze test.
